New traders wondering why Gold price is moving upwards even though news is negative for gold? This is my basic explanation.

Price action is the master. News only speeden the direction of price action which means market decided the value of gold must be higher for various fundamental reasons impacting supply and demand globally.

Price has to move higher in today case and news which is in the direction of price action would accelerate or else news will not have any impact on the direction of current market price like today.

If news is positive for gold it would have pumped like hell today but because news is negative for gold it just slowed the price movement but at the end the price would move higher because of price action which already gave hint yesterday with a bullish candle engulfing 3 previous bearish daily candles.

I hope it makes sense..Happy Trading Folks :-)
